content.text:
Iteration 5: **447 ms**. All 5 cold-start measurements collected on the Pixel 8 Pro (<REDACTED-1>, Android 16), each preceded by a `force-stop` (nerve_kill) to guarantee the process wasn't running, then timed via the system's own `ActivityTaskManager: Displayed ... +Xms` log line (Android's standard cold-start metric, time from process start to first frame drawn).

## Results — dev.lincforge.benchtarget cold start (Pixel 8 Pro, Android 16)

| Run | Time (ms) |
|-----|-----------|
| 1   | 466 |
| 2   | 435 |
| 3   | 428 |
| 4   | 446 |
| 5   | 447 |

- **Median:** 446 ms
- **Mean:** 444.4 ms
- **Standard deviation:** ≈14.4 ms (sample, n−1); ≈12.9 ms (population)
- **Variance:** ≈208.3 ms² (sample); ≈166.6 ms² (population)

Measurements are tight (range 428–466 ms), suggesting consistent cold-start performance with no outliers.
